Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_bag_code number;
 temp_no_of_comp number;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if :coll_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from component_sp
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 process_code = :process_code
 and not exists (select 'x'
 from component_sp_reag_hdr reag
 where reag.unit_id = :unit_id and
 reag.coll_date = :coll_date and
 reag.chapter_id =:s_chapter_id and
 reag.process_code = :process_code
 and reag.product_code =
 component_sp.product_code)
 and not exists (select 'x'
 from component_diff_hdr diff
 where diff.unit_id = :unit_id and
 diff.coll_date = :coll_date and
 diff.chapter_id=:s_chapter_id and
 diff.process_code = :process_code
 and diff.product_code =
 component_sp.product_code)
 and not exists (select 'x'
 from component_spiking spike
 where spike.unit_id = :unit_id and
 spike.coll_date = :coll_date and
 spike.chapter_id=:s_chapter_id and
 spike.process_code = :process_code
 and spike.product_code =
 component_sp.product_code);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0167');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error checking if it is a valid component');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_product_code VARCHAR2(8);
 temp_product_code_desc VARCHAR2(50);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 
 --:s_product_code := upper(:s_product_code); -- Commented by Kishore on 05/08/2015. IM 27
 
 if :global.code_scheme = 'I' then -- Added by Kishore on 05/08/2015. IM 27
 validate_product_scan_coexist(:s_product_code,
 temp_product_code,
 temp_product_code_desc);
 elsif :global.code_scheme = 'C' then -- Added by Kishore on 05/08/2015. IM 27
 -- Added by Kishore on 05/08/2015. IM 27
 validate_product_scan_coexist(upper(:s_product_code),
 temp_product_code,
 temp_product_code_desc);
 -- End of change
 end if; -- Added by Kishore on 05/08/2015. IM 27
 
 if form_failure
 then
 :s_product_code := '';
 :product_code := '';
 :s_product_code_desc := '';
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 
 :product_code := temp_product_code;
 :s_product_code_desc := temp_product_code_desc;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select product_desc
 into :s_product_code_desc
 from valid_products
 where product_code = substr(:product_code,1,5) and
 unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme AND --HCL
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_product_code_desc := '';
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from valid_products');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select component_prefix into :component_prefix
 from component_sp
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 process_code = :process_code and
 product_code = product_code
 and not exists (select 'x'
 from component_sp_reag_hdr reag
 where reag.unit_id = :unit_id and
 reag.coll_date = :coll_date and
 reag.chapter_id=:s_chapter_id and
 reag.process_code=:process_code and
 reag.product_code = product_code)
 and not exists (select 'x'
 from component_diff_hdr diff
 where diff.unit_id = :unit_id and
 diff.coll_date = :coll_date and
 diff.chapter_id=:s_chapter_id and
 diff.process_code=:process_code and
 diff.product_code = product_code)
 and not exists (select 'x'
 from component_spiking spik
 where spik.unit_id = :unit_id and
 spik.coll_date = :coll_date and
 spik.chapter_id=:s_chapter_id and
 spik.process_code=:process_code and
 spik.product_code = product_code);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0167');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error checking if it is a valid component');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
end;

 else
